rule: Background 8, with a 6 at the bottom-left. The region is the set of 8-cells 4-reachable from the 6. A 1-object (8-connected) survives if it 8-touches the region; otherwise it is erased to 8. Surviving objects that touch the grid border are walls. A region cell becomes 7 if it is on the grid border or 8-adjacent to a wall cell. The 6 is not a wall. Floating survivors and unreachable pockets are unchanged.
scope: Fixed-palette bottom-left-marker reachability, whole-object erasure and framing only border-connected surviving objects. Procedural no-separator, full-line, L-corner and U-box partitions, mixed border and floating shapes; native dimensions10..30, original fixtures10..20. Explicit latent rectangle unions reconstruct all four canonical pairs.

authored_scope: Random scenes are 10..30 per side. 10..20 matches the fixtures; 21..30 is a synthetic extension. The 6 is fixed at bottom-left and the palette is fixed. The separator modes none/line/corner/box cut off unreachable pockets, which hold 0..3 erased objects; an empty pocket keeps its border cells as 8. The reachable side has border-attached rectangles, bars, staircases, corner blocks and compound shapes, plus floating blobs that survive unframed. A wall two cells from the 6 is placed sometimes, to exercise framing of the cell diagonal to the 6. Not supported: other marker positions, palette changes, and objects inside the 6's 8-neighbourhood. An explicit-object path reconstructs the fixtures exactly.
authored_constraints: Exactly one 6, at (h-1,0). No 1-cell lies within Chebyshev distance 1 of it.
Latent objects are pairwise non-8-adjacent and each is 8-connected, so the 1-components equal the latent objects.
Every reachable-side object and the separator still touch the final region. A placement that would sever an earlier object is refused, after recomputing the region.
Far-pocket objects are unreachable and never 8-touch the region, because they are 8-separated from the separator.
1-cells cover less than 45% of the grid, so 8 is the majority background.
Every random scene has at least one wall, and the output always differs from the input because (h-2,0) is a border region cell.
Height and width must be non-bool integers. Random-path sides are 10..30; explicit-path sides are 1..30.
